title: Tower of Hanoi
description: Solve the classic mathematical puzzle by moving the disks to the final tower.
about:
Tower of Hanoi is a browser game where you move the stack of disks to the destination peg, moving one disk at a time and never placing a larger disk on a smaller one.

Start a round in your browser and use the controls below to play.
howToPlay: Move the stack of disks to the destination peg, moving one disk at a time and never placing a larger disk on a smaller one.

controls.action: Select a disk and destination peg

tips: Use click / tap to select a disk and destination peg.
Try another round to practice the timing and strategy.

faq.question: How do I play Tower of Hanoi?
faq.answer: Move the stack of disks to the destination peg, moving one disk at a time and never placing a larger disk on a smaller one.

faq.question: Can I play Tower of Hanoi in a browser?
faq.answer: Yes. Open the game page and play without installing an app.
